messages:
maria: Quick sync: Sherpa (Acme Labs) dedicated pool activation — need final preflight for autoscale & quota. Target: 1500 QPS beta, p95 < 200ms for gen-8k. Who's on tomorrow's window? TL;DR below.

ton.y: I can lead the autoscale policy tuning. I'll need expected RPS ramp plan, steady-state, and burst windows.

maria: Ramp plan attached: 0->300 qps over 5m, ->800 over 10m, ->1500 over 15m, hold 30m, hammer 2500 for 3m. We'll do staging -> canary -> prod routing.

ashley: SRE question: confirm node types (A100-80x or T4?) and max concurrent per node. Also any KV-cache priming steps? :eyes:

liam: Platform eng here — pool is p-dedicated-gpu-a100-80x, 40 GPUs across 10 nodes. Default max concurrent per node is 16. KV cache will be cold; recommend prefix warmup script.

maria: Warmup script (run on staging before canary):
```bash
# warmup.sh
for i in $(seq 1 10000); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"sherpa-gen-8k","input":"warmup prompt"}' >/dev/null &
  sleep 0.01
done
```

tony: For autoscale: propose policy: scale up at 70% GPU util sustained 90s, scale down at 30% sustained 300s. Add extra headroom for bursts. :+1:

ashley: Also need fallback policy: if p95 > 500ms for >2m automatically switch to smaller model or limit max tokens. Can we prepare a compatible model variant? @liam

liam: We have sherpa-lite-quant (8-bit) — functional parity on most prompts. I'll stage it into the canary pool and test inference parity.

maria: Load test schedule (customer window is in UTC): staging 09:00-09:45, canary 10:00-10:30, prod dry-run 11:00-11:40, full prod 12:00-13:00. Who's on-call for the 12:00 slot?

ashley: I'll be on-call 11:30-13:30. Please invite me to the incident channel.

tony: I'll own traffic shaping and run k6. Adding perf thresholds to the runbook. Sample k6 snippet will be in ops.

maria: Cost note for customer: estimated token burn ~12M tokens for full stress ~ $4.2k extra for the test. @kevin-sales flagged. Might affect renewal conversation.

kevin-sales: Acknowledged, will confirm with customer. Renewal meeting next week — if onboarding looks smooth we'll call out projected lower per-token after autoscale tuning.

maria: Final ask: everyone paste ✓ when done with preflight tasks (quota confirm, warmup uploaded, fallback model staged, runbook ack).

liam: ✓ warmed up canary, staged sherpa-lite-quant.

tony: ✓ k6 scripts uploaded to ops/sherpa/loadtests/1749993333.json, autoscale policy pushed to cluster.

ashley: ✓ on-call scheduled, incident channel created #incident-sherpa-1749993333

maria: ✓ customer informed about cost and timeline. Thanks team — I'll post the final runbook in this thread in 15m.
